content: Aramas suwed kin tangdoaui mehnda ma sohte me pwakipwakih, ahpw aramas lelepek kin kommwad duwehte laion.
Ni wehi ehu eh kin dipada, kaun akan kin wiliali. Ahpw wehi ehu pahn kehlail oh poatopoat ma kaun akan pahn kupwurokong oh koahiek.
Kaun emen me kin kahpwalihala me semwehmwe kan, rasehng keteu uk me kin kauwehla wahnsahpw.
Ma ke sohte kesempwalki kosonned, ke uhki aramas suwed kan; ahpw ma ke kapwaiada, ke uhwong aramas suwed kan.
Aramas suwed sohte ese dahkot pwuhng, ahpw irail kan me kin pwongih KAUN-O kin wehwehki.
Semwehmwe oh lelepek mwahusang kepwehpwe oh mwersuwed.
Mwahnakapw emen me peikiong kosonned me loalokong. Mehmen me kompoakepahnki aramas me sohte katepe kan kin kanamenekihala seme.
Ma ke kepwehpwehla pwehki omw kalaudehla pweinen omw dipwisou oh kapweipwei aramas akan, omw pai pahn kolahng emen me kin kadekohng me semwehmwe kan.
Ma ke sohte peikiong kosonned, Koht pahn ketin kalahdeki karonge omw kapakap akan.
Ma ke pahn pitih aramas lelepek men pwehn wia me suwed, ke pahn pein pwupwudiong nan omw lidip. Me mwakelekel kan pahn ale keting mwahu.
Aramas kepwehpwe kin medemedewe me re me loalokong ahnsou koaros, ahpw aramas semwehmwe me kak kasawih loalen aramas mwahusang irail.
Ni aramas mwahu men eh kin kesepwilda wiahla kaun emen, aramas koaros kin perenkihda, ahpw ni aramas suwed kan ar kin kaunda wasa, aramas akan kin rukula.
Omw mour sohte pahn pweida ma ke song en ekihla dipomw kan. Sakarkihda oh wiliakapwala; eri, Koht ahpw pahn ketin mahkikihong uhk.
Peikiong KAUN-O ahnsou koaros, ke ahpw pahn nsenamwahu. Ma ke keptakai, ke pahn ohla.
Aramas paisuwed kan sohte ar kehl pohn kaun suwed men, pwe e me keper rasehng laion emen me wie ngiringir de pehr men me reperepen mwengeseli.
Kaun emen me sohte eh lamalam mwahu pahn wiahla kaun lemei men. Mehmen me kin kailongki mwersuwed pahn wia kaun emen ahnsou reirei.
Aramas emen me dipikidahr dipen kamaramas pein ih weweir eh sousou ni karuaru. Ke dehr song en katokehdi.
Lelepek, ke ahpw pahn saledek sang apwal. Ma ke pahn mwersuwed, ke pahn mwadangete pwupwudi.
Soumwet men me kin doadoahk laud kin mie eh tungoal kisin mwenge tohto. Aramas emen me kin kauwehla mwahl ahnsou pahn semwehmwe kohkohlahte.
Aramas lelepek kan pahn ahneki mour mwahu oh nsenamwahu. Ahpw ma ke karuaru en kepwehpwehla, ke pahn ale lokolok.
Uhpalihki emen aramas sohte mwahu. Ahpw ekei sounkopwung pahn kin wiahda sapwung pwehki kisin pweipwei sapwung kis me re alehsang emen.
Aramas mehwo kan kin karuaru en kepwehpwehla me kahrehda re sohte ese iahd me paisuwed pahn lelohng irail.
Kapwungala emen, ke ahpw pahn ale kasapahlkalahngan laud sang ma ke kapinga.
Mehmen me lemeleme me kaidehn mehkot suwed pirapa seme oh ine, e sohte mwahusang sounpirap akan.
Mehwo kin kahrehdahte kahpwal. E pahn mwahu mehlel ma ke likih KAUN-O.
Aramas pweipwei men me kin idawehnte pein eh kaweid. Ke pahn mourla ma ke idawehn padahk en me kupwurokong sang uhk kan.
Kihong me semwehmwe kan, ke ahpw pahn sohte anahnehda mehkot. Ma ke sohpeisang me semwehmwe kan, aramas tohto pahn kerieiukala.
Aramas kin rukula ni ahnsou me aramas suwed men kin kesepwilda wiahla kaun. Ahpw ni ar kin pwupwusang nan dewerail, me pwung kan pahn pwurehng kaunda.
